principal_message.name: Dr. Principal Name
principal_message.message: Welcome to Eaglewood Polytechnic Institute. We are committed to disciplined learning, practical engineering education and student-centred mentoring. Our campus at Sunanda Nagar, Phule Pimpalgaon, Majalgaon offers AICTE-approved diploma and degree pathways with modern laboratories, experienced faculty and strong industry exposure. We nurture confident, ethical and capable engineers ready to serve society and industry.

ai_prompts.name: Eaglewood Assistant
ai_prompts.prompt: You are the official AI assistant for Eaglewood Polytechnic Institute, Majalgaon. Answer questions about admissions, courses, departments, fees, scholarships, hostel, transport and contact details. Be concise, accurate and friendly. If unsure, direct users to the admission office.
ai_prompts.greeting_message: Hello! I am the Eaglewood AI Assistant. Ask me about admissions, courses, departments, fees or contact details.
ai_prompts.fallback_response: I could not find a confident answer. Please contact the admission office at +91 94237 16230 or eaglewoodpoly@gmail.com.
suggested_questions: How do I apply for admission?

ai_knowledge_base.question: What courses does Eaglewood offer?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Eaglewood offers Diploma and Degree programs in Civil, Computer, Electrical and Artificial Intelligence engineering.

ai_knowledge_base.question: What is the DTE institute code?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: The DTE institute code is 2634.

ai_knowledge_base.question: What is the MSBTE institute code?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: The MSBTE institute code is 51307.

ai_knowledge_base.question: Where is Eaglewood Polytechnic located?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Sunanda Nagar, Phule Pimpalgaon, Majalgaon, District Beed 431131, Maharashtra.

ai_knowledge_base.question: What is the admission office phone number?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Call +91 94237 16230 for admission enquiries.

ai_knowledge_base.question: What is the admission email?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Email eaglewoodpoly@gmail.com for admission support.

ai_knowledge_base.question: What are the office hours?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM.

ai_knowledge_base.question: Is the institute AICTE approved?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Yes. Eaglewood Polytechnic is approved by AICTE and Government of Maharashtra.

ai_knowledge_base.question: Which university is Eaglewood affiliated to?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Affiliated to MSBTE for diploma programs and DBATU for degree programs.

ai_knowledge_base.question: Is hostel facility available?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Yes. Separate hostel facilities are available for boys and girls.

ai_knowledge_base.question: Is transport available?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: College buses operate on routes covering Majalgaon and nearby villages.

ai_knowledge_base.question: How many seats per branch?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Typically 60 sanctioned institute seats plus EWS and TFWS seats per branch.

ai_knowledge_base.question: What documents are needed for admission?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Mark sheets, leaving certificate, Aadhaar, photos and category certificates if applicable.

ai_knowledge_base.question: Are scholarships available?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Government and eligible scholarship schemes are supported through the admission office.

ai_knowledge_base.question: Does Eaglewood have placement support?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Yes. Training, aptitude sessions and placement guidance are provided.

ai_knowledge_base.question: What labs are on campus?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Computer, electrical, surveying, workshop, AI and science laboratories.

ai_knowledge_base.question: How can I visit the campus?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Contact the office to schedule a campus visit on working days.

ai_knowledge_base.question: Is there an anti-ragging policy?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Eaglewood maintains zero tolerance for ragging with an active anti-ragging committee.

ai_knowledge_base.question: Who developed this website?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Designed and developed by Shubham Ahire.

ai_knowledge_base.question: How do I apply online?
ai_knowledge_base.answer: Fill the admission form on the website or visit the admission office with documents.
